headline: UnitedHealth Group (UNH) Stock Sees Fair Value Lift After Q2 Analyst Target Increases
summary: UnitedHealth Group has seen its analyst fair value estimate move from $424.23 to $475.23, a shift of about 12% in the underlying price target framework. Recent research attributes this change to Q2 earnings, updates around Medicare Advantage and Optum Health, and refreshed 2026 earnings models. These are cited as key reasons many analysts are resetting their targets higher while still flagging risks around commercial trends, Medicaid, and ongoing regulatory scrutiny. headline: Gravie Appoints Former Optum Executive Eric Murphy to Board of Directors, Announces Funding Round Led by General Atlantic
summary: Gravie, the health benefits company redefining how employers and their employees access and pay for healthcare, today announced the appointment of Eric Murphy, a veteran healthcare executive and former Optum leader, to its Board of Directors. The company also announced the closing of a new funding round led by General Atlantic, bringing Gravie's total capital raised to $463 million.
